title: Senior web developer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior web developer em itupeva. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs). You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon. Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

O foco principal será desenvolver  módulos Terraform reutilizáveis  , estruturando a base de infraestrutura que suporta nossos pipelines e produtos de dados.  É uma função para alguém com forte senioridade técnica, atuando na interseção entre  engenharia de dados  ,  cloud  e  automação  .  Responsabilidades e atribuições    Criar e evoluir  módulos Terraform  para padronizar componentes da plataforma de dados (redes, IAM, storage, computação, pipelines etc.);   Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter  pipelines e processos ETL/ELT  , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade;   Estabelecer padrões e boas práticas de  Data Ops  , incluindo versionamento, testes, deployments e monitoramento;   Dar suporte técnico e consultivo aos times de dados, ajudando a estruturar soluções robustas e alinhadas à arquitetura corporativa;  Implementar mecanismos de  governança  , segurança e otimização de custos em ambientes de dados na nuvem.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência sólida com  Terraform  e infraestrutura como código;   Vivência prática em  cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados;   Forte conhecimento em  pipelines  ,  ETL/ELT  e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse);   Proficiência em  Python  e  SQL;    Experiência com  CI/CD  aplicado a dados e automação;   Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.    Diferenciais   Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;  Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;  Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);  Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.    Perfil comportamental   Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;  Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;  Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma.    BENEFÍ CIOS DESSA POSIÇÃ O   Participação em Lucros e Resultados;  Carro Corporativo;  Descontos em Aluguel, Assinatura e Compra de veículos;  Programa de Livre Escolha (Reembolso de Despesas Médicas);  Vale Alimentação e Refeição;  Allya;  Auxílio Home office;  Wellhub;  Plano de Saúde;  Plano Odontológico;  Seguro de Vida.

title: Senior web developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior web developer em toledo. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior web developer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior web developer em santana de parnaíba. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior web developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior web developer em cajamar. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations. Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.  Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.  In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.  To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.  While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed. title: Senior outsystems engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior outsystems engineer em londrina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Senior Out Systems Engineer  About the Role   We are seeking a Senior Out Systems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.  This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.  What You’ll Do   Stabilize and Modernize Architecture   Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies  Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability  Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows  Optimize Database and System Performance   Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies  Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database  Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns  Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance  Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability   Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues  Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations  Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health  Build a Real Release Pipeline   Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline  Configure deployment automation using Out Systems APIs  Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls  Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing  Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing   Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities  Remove unused or redundant components  Define governance for capacity-impacting changes  Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality  Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform   Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes  Map data entities into portable schemas  Capture business logic embedded within the platform  Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components  Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows  What You Bring   Required Experience   5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale Out Systems applications  Deep experience with Out Systems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API  Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements  Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures  Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within Out Systems  Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments  Preferred Experience   Experience supporting or leading Out Systems to custom platform migrations  Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows  Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling  Experience with license optimization and application object management  Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems  Working Environment   Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership  Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions  Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations  Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users  This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

We are scaling fast and hiring the person who will keep the entire operation running like a machine.  The Role   We are hiring an  Operations & Project Manager  to serve as the execution backbone of the business and the primary management layer between our COO and our team.  This is  not  a coordinator role. This is a real management position with real authority.  You will own our operational rhythm, enforce accountability across every function, resolve blockers before they become problems, and ensure the entire team executes with precision, without the COO needing to be involved in day-to-day issues.  If things fall through the cracks, it is your job to catch them before anyone else notices.  Remote | Growth path to COO  What You Will Own    Click Up Environment  Own the Click Up workspace as the single source of truth for all work in progress. Enforce task hygiene daily. Audit weekly. Onboard new team members to standards.   Deadline Tracking & Escalation  Monitor all active tasks and projects for deadline risk proactively. Maintain a weekly at-risk task list. Surface root cause analysis to the COO when patterns emerge.   Meeting Cadence Ownership  Own all recurring meetings end to end: Daily Standup, Weekly 1:1s, COO Operations Review, Project Kickoffs, and Monthly Ops Review. Agendas distributed 24 hours in advance. Notes and action items distributed within 24 hours of each meeting.   Cross-Team Coordination & Blocker Resolution  Serve as the coordination layer between all functions. No team member should be stuck on a blocker for more than 24 hours without a resolution plan.   Workload & Priority Management  Monitor workload distribution across the team. Surface imbalances to the COO with recommended reallocation before output is affected.   KPI Dashboard Management  Own the weekly KPI reporting cycle. Compile and present the consolidated dashboard to the COO weekly. Flag all missed KPIs immediately with root cause and action plan.   Operational SOP Library  Own the company's full SOP library. Every recurring operational workflow documented and current.   Team Accountability  Hold every team member directly accountable for tasks, deadlines, and Click Up hygiene, without involving the COO in routine accountability conversations. title: Gerente de projetos de ti sênior
description:
Nova oportunidade para Gerente de projetos de ti sênior em franco da rocha. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.  Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.  Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS.  Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).  Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.    Informações Adicionais   Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica) Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil) Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos) Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte) Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Direct-response creative strategist
description:
Confira a vaga para Direct-response creative strategist em araraquara. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About us Clickbait Agency is a You Tube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on You Tube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.  We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.  We think You Tube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.  The role  We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script You Tube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.  You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.  You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.  What we’re looking for  We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.  You should have:  2+ years writing direct response video ads for You Tube or Facebook  A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic  Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts  The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative  Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale  Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow    Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.  What we offer  Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.  You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.  This is a fully remote position.  One thing worth knowing  There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing.  Apply Here:

title: Senior web developer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior web developer em nova odessa. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Senior outsystems engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior outsystems engineer em embu. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Senior Out Systems Engineer  About the Role   We are seeking a Senior Out Systems Engineer to lead platform stabilization and migration readiness efforts for a large-scale clinical application supporting 130+ locations nationwide. This is a highly hands-on, high-impact role focused on improving system performance, reducing risk, and preparing the platform for an eventual transition to a custom-built solution.  This engagement is expected to begin late April or early May and run approximately 6 weeks, with strong potential for extension based on performance.  What You’ll Do   Stabilize and Modernize Architecture   Assess tightly coupled module architecture and reduce dependencies  Identify and execute module extraction strategies to improve scalability  Minimize risk and blast radius of ongoing changes without disrupting workflows  Optimize Database and System Performance   Improve database performance by optimizing queries and implementing indexing strategies  Design and execute migration of binary large objects out of the database  Replace inefficient polling with event-driven or conditional patterns  Implement backpressure controls for integrations impacting system performance  Reduce Error Noise and Improve Observability   Identify and remediate recurring error patterns masking real issues  Refactor exception handling and client-side lifecycle violations  Establish a clean, monitorable baseline for system health  Build a Real Release Pipeline   Establish a true multi-environment deployment pipeline  Configure deployment automation using Out Systems APIs  Implement gated release processes with approvals and controls  Ensure non-production environments support meaningful regression testing  Manage Platform Capacity and Licensing   Audit platform usage and identify optimization opportunities  Remove unused or redundant components  Define governance for capacity-impacting changes  Extend platform headroom without impacting functionality  Prepare for Migration to Custom Platform   Document all integrations including triggers, data contracts, and failure modes  Map data entities into portable schemas  Capture business logic embedded within the platform  Identify core business logic vs platform-generated components  Advise on migration sequencing and risk across workflows  What You Bring   Required Experience   5+ years building and maintaining enterprise-scale Out Systems applications  Deep experience with Out Systems 11, Service Studio, and Lifetime API  Proven success optimizing performance including query tuning and data model improvements  Experience refactoring complex, tightly coupled systems into modular architectures  Strong SQL Server performance tuning experience including execution plans and indexing  Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation within Out Systems  Strong problem-solving skills in live production environments  Preferred Experience   Experience supporting or leading Out Systems to custom platform migrations  Background in healthcare or clinical systems with understanding of critical workflows  Familiarity with HIPAA considerations and secure data handling  Experience with license optimization and application object management  Knowledge of integration patterns across scheduling, e-signature, or CRM systems  Working Environment   Collaborate closely with internal engineering and PM leadership  Operate with high autonomy and ownership of technical decisions  Work within a live production environment supporting critical clinical operations  Balance speed and precision while minimizing risk to end users  This is a unique opportunity to step into a complex, high-visibility system, make immediate impact, and shape the foundation for a next-generation platform.

Sobre a Allinsert:   A Allinsert é uma empresa nacional com sólida experiência no mercado de manufatura eletrônica, atuando desde 2005 na montagem de placas e produtos eletrônicos (Contract Manufacturing). Localizada em Pinhais, Paraná, nossa unidade fabril de mais de 1.000m² conta com três modernas linhas SMD e uma linha PTH, equipadas com tecnologia de ponta para garantir a mais alta qualidade em nossos processos. Atendemos clientes de diversos segmentos, desde a prototipagem até a produção em larga escala, sempre prezando pela qualidade, agilidade e segurança. Na Allinsert, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo e o desenvolvimento profissional.      Objetivo da Posição:    Buscamos um profissional para integrar nossa equipe de produção como Auxiliar de Produção I, com foco na inspeção de qualidade da montagem de placas de circuito impresso (PCI). Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para quem deseja iniciar sua carreira na indústria eletrônica, aprendendo sobre os processos de fabricação e garantindo a excelência do nosso serviço.  Principais Funções:    Análise de perfil de solda:  Verificar a qualidade da soldagem, identificando defeitos como solda fria, excesso de solda, bolhas ou rachaduras.   Inspeção de componentes montados:  Conferir se os componentes estão posicionados corretamente e bem fixados nas placas.   Verificação de polaridade:  Identificar resistores, diodos, capacitores eletrolíticos e transistores montados de forma invertida.   Inspeção de conectores e terminais:  Checar a integridade dos conectores e terminais, verificando a ausência de curtos-circuitos ou trilhas rompidas na PCI.   Registro de não conformidades:  Documentar de forma precisa os defeitos recorrentes encontrados durante a inspeção e comunicar as informações ao time de engenharia de qualidade.   Retrabalho de placas defeituosas (quando necessário):  Realizar a remoção e substituição de componentes defeituosos, seguindo os procedimentos estabelecidos.   Sugestão de melhorias:  Identificar padrões de erros na montagem e proativamente sugerir ajustes no processo de fabricação para evitar recorrências.   Seguir normas de qualidade:  Cumprir rigorosamente os procedimentos e normas de qualidade implementados, em conformidade com a norma ISO 9001.   Preenchimento de relatórios:  Registrar de forma clara e organizada os problemas identificados durante as inspeções, garantindo a rastreabilidade dos lotes analisados.    Buscamos em você:    Interesse em aprender:  Forte desejo de adquirir novos conhecimentos sobre processos de produção eletrônica e inspeção de qualidade.   Capacidade de comunicação:  Habilidade para expressar dúvidas de forma clara e buscar feedback para aprimorar seu trabalho.   Responsabilidade:  Compromisso com os horários de trabalho e com a presença na empresa.   Comprometimento:  Dedicação à qualidade do trabalho e consciência do seu papel como contribuinte para um ambiente de trabalho positivo.   Posicionamento Pró-ativo:  Iniciativa para buscar atividades e ajudar mesmo quando sua tarefa principal não tiver demanda imediata, visando a melhoria contínua da empresa.   Conforto fora da zona de conforto:  Disposição para enfrentar novos desafios e aprender novas tarefas, saindo da rotina quando necessário.    Diferenciais (Não Obrigatórios):   Conhecimento básico em componentes eletrônicos.  Familiaridade com processos de montagem eletrônica (SMD e PTH).    O que oferecemos:   Oportunidade de iniciar sua carreira em uma empresa sólida e em crescimento no setor de eletrônica.  Treinamento e desenvolvimento profissional.  Ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e que valoriza a iniciativa.  Salário inicial R$2,011.68 Vale Refeição R$22,00/dia    Jornada de trabalho:   Segunda à quinta feira das 7:30 às 17:30 e  Sexta feira das 7:30 às 16:30.  Não trabalhamos aos sábados.    Se você se identifica com esta oportunidade e possui o perfil que buscamos, candidate-se e venha fazer parte da equipe Allinsert!

This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations. While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.  Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.  Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS.  Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).  Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.    Informações Adicionais   Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica) Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil) Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos) Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte) Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Direct-response creative strategist
description:
Empresa está contratando Direct-response creative strategist em tubarão. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About us Clickbait Agency is a You Tube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on You Tube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.  We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.  We think You Tube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.  The role  We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script You Tube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.  You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. Your scripts go through our AI production team, so the output is fast and the feedback loop is short.  You’ll be working across multiple 8 and 9-figure brands simultaneously. The work is demanding and the bar is high.  What we’re looking for  We’re only looking for people who are genuinely good at this. If you’re earlier in your career or still developing your DR fundamentals, this isn’t the right fit yet.  You should have:  2+ years writing direct response video ads for You Tube or Facebook  A real understanding of Eugene Schwartz’s awareness stages and how to apply them to cold traffic  Experience scripting hooks, mini VSLs, and full ad concepts  The ability to look at performance data and use it to build the next creative  Proven spend behind your work — creatives you’ve written that have run profitably at scale  Comfort using AI tools as part of your day-to-day workflow    Experience in compliance-sensitive categories like supplements or weight loss is a bonus. So is familiarity with unique mechanism development and RMBC.  What we offer  Base salary with a performance bonus tied to winning creatives. When your work scales, your compensation reflects that.  You’ll have access to proprietary AI tools built specifically for our workflow, a production team that handles execution, and a team around you that takes the work seriously.  This is a fully remote position.  One thing worth knowing  There’s a short test task as part of the application process. It’s there to see how you think, not to take your time for nothing. Responsabilidades e atribuições    Criar e evoluir  módulos Terraform  para padronizar componentes da plataforma de dados (redes, IAM, storage, computação, pipelines etc.);   Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter  pipelines e processos ETL/ELT  , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade;   Estabelecer padrões e boas práticas de  Data Ops  , incluindo versionamento, testes, deployments e monitoramento;   Dar suporte técnico e consultivo aos times de dados, ajudando a estruturar soluções robustas e alinhadas à arquitetura corporativa;  Implementar mecanismos de  governança  , segurança e otimização de custos em ambientes de dados na nuvem.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência sólida com  Terraform  e infraestrutura como código;   Vivência prática em  cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados;   Forte conhecimento em  pipelines  ,  ETL/ELT  e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse);   Proficiência em  Python  e  SQL;    Experiência com  CI/CD  aplicado a dados e automação;   Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.    Diferenciais   Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;  Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;  Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);  Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.    Perfil comportamental   Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;  Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;  Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma.    BENEFÍ CIOS DESSA POSIÇÃ O   Participação em Lucros e Resultados;  Carro Corporativo;  Descontos em Aluguel, Assinatura e Compra de veículos;  Programa de Livre Escolha (Reembolso de Despesas Médicas);  Vale Alimentação e Refeição;  Allya;  Auxílio Home office;  Wellhub;  Plano de Saúde;  Plano Odontológico;  Seguro de Vida.

title: Senior web developer
description:
Empresa está contratando Senior web developer em pouso alegre. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

We are scaling fast and hiring the person who will keep the entire operation running like a machine. This is  not  a coordinator role. This is a real management position with real authority.  You will own our operational rhythm, enforce accountability across every function, resolve blockers before they become problems, and ensure the entire team executes with precision, without the COO needing to be involved in day-to-day issues.  If things fall through the cracks, it is your job to catch them before anyone else notices. Onboard new team members to standards.   Deadline Tracking & Escalation  Monitor all active tasks and projects for deadline risk proactively. Maintain a weekly at-risk task list. Surface root cause analysis to the COO when patterns emerge.   Meeting Cadence Ownership  Own all recurring meetings end to end: Daily Standup, Weekly 1:1s, COO Operations Review, Project Kickoffs, and Monthly Ops Review. Agendas distributed 24 hours in advance. Notes and action items distributed within 24 hours of each meeting.   Cross-Team Coordination & Blocker Resolution  Serve as the coordination layer between all functions. No team member should be stuck on a blocker for more than 24 hours without a resolution plan.   Workload & Priority Management  Monitor workload distribution across the team. Surface imbalances to the COO with recommended reallocation before output is affected.   KPI Dashboard Management  Own the weekly KPI reporting cycle. Compile and present the consolidated dashboard to the COO weekly. Flag all missed KPIs immediately with root cause and action plan.   Operational SOP Library  Own the company's full SOP library. Every recurring operational workflow documented and current.   Team Accountability  Hold every team member directly accountable for tasks, deadlines, and Click Up hygiene, without involving the COO in routine accountability conversations. Phase 1 is about building credibility through execution discipline and demonstrating the judgment to manage independently. Empresa está contratando Back end developer em bauru. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About the Role  Staffing Abroad is seeking a  Senior Backend Engineer/ Senior Software Engineer  to join a #1 US-based Fin Tech & Crypto company  . This role is ideal for a highly skilled backend developer who excels in  C#/. NET  and has a strong focus on  writing maintainable, scalable, and secure code  . You will play a key role in shaping architecture, ensuring system performance, and embedding best practices while working in a fast-paced and innovative environment.  This is a 100% remote, full-time role  Salary $5.000 USD to $6.000 USD  English C1 required   What You Will Do    Develop and Maintain Applications  : Build, enhance, and maintain secure, scalable backend services using C#/. NET and integrate with APIs like Plaid, Dwolla, and Treasury Prime.   Shape System Architecture  : Contribute to system design, ensuring performance, scalability, and security across Fin Tech applications.   Write Quality Code  : Implement and test maintainable, well-documented code, with a focus on automation and software best practices.   Support Production Systems  : Monitor and troubleshoot production applications to ensure high availability and quick issue resolution.   Collaborate Across Teams  : Work closely with front-end, QA, product, and IT teams, while mentoring junior engineers.  Focus on Security and Compliance  : Embed security best practices and maintain compliance with Fin Tech regulations.    What You Will Need    Strong Technical Expertise  :   Solid foundation in design patterns, software development best practices, and principles like SOLID and Clean Code.  Proficiency in C#/. NET, ASP. NET MVC/Web API, and Object-Relational Mappers (ORMs).  Strong understanding of MSSQL database design and optimization.  Familiarity with asynchronous microservices architecture and distributed systems.  Experience with modern front-end and server-side technologies such as Node.js and React.  Commitment to Software Quality  :   Hands-on experience with unit testing, mocking, integration testing, and ensuring code coverage.  Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, particularly in Azure Dev Ops.  Proficient in version control systems, especially Git.  Experience and Education  :  6+ years of back-end software development experience.  Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field (preferred).  Collaboration and Communication  :   Excellent written and verbal communication skills.  Ability to work effectively with team members and stakeholders.  Enthusiasm for contributing to a collaborative, dynamic team environment.  Cultural Fit  :   Passion for innovation, accountability, and teamwork.  Alignment with a culture that prioritizes excellence in Fin Tech and Crypto solutions.    Plusses Include    Experience with  i Design architecture methodology  .   Familiarity with  cloud platforms  such as Azure, including their tools and services.

title: Forensic manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Forensic manager em anápolis. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations. Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.  Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.  In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.  To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.  While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.  For more information, please see our  video

title: Especialista em dataops (cloud & data platform) | remoto
description:
Nova oportunidade para Especialista em dataops (cloud & data platform) | remoto em garibaldi. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

MOBI7 A Mobi7 é uma empresa que utiliza a tecnologia para criar soluções que otimizam a mobilidade, auxiliam na gestão e valorizam a segurança no trânsito. Hoje, nós fazemos parte das empresas da Localiza e temos uma plataforma de gestão de frotas corporativas, criada para monitorar e otimizar o uso de veículos leves ou pesados. E esse é só o começo  O QUE BUSCAMOS:   Buscamos um(a)  Especialista em Data Ops  para liderar a padronização e evolução da nossa plataforma de dados.  O foco principal será desenvolver  módulos Terraform reutilizáveis  , estruturando a base de infraestrutura que suporta nossos pipelines e produtos de dados.  É uma função para alguém com forte senioridade técnica, atuando na interseção entre  engenharia de dados  ,  cloud  e  automação  .  Responsabilidades e atribuições    Criar e evoluir  módulos Terraform  para padronizar componentes da plataforma de dados (redes, IAM, storage, computação, pipelines etc.);   Arquitetar, desenvolver e manter  pipelines e processos ETL/ELT  , garantindo qualidade, escalabilidade e observabilidade;   Estabelecer padrões e boas práticas de  Data Ops  , incluindo versionamento, testes, deployments e monitoramento;   Dar suporte técnico e consultivo aos times de dados, ajudando a estruturar soluções robustas e alinhadas à arquitetura corporativa;  Implementar mecanismos de  governança  , segurança e otimização de custos em ambientes de dados na nuvem.    Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência sólida com  Terraform  e infraestrutura como código;   Vivência prática em  cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados;   Forte conhecimento em  pipelines  ,  ETL/ELT  e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse);   Proficiência em  Python  e  SQL;    Experiência com  CI/CD  aplicado a dados e automação;   Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.    Diferenciais   Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;  Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;  Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);  Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.    Perfil comportamental   Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;  Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;  Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma.    BENEFÍ CIOS DESSA POSIÇÃ O   Participação em Lucros e Resultados;  Carro Corporativo;  Descontos em Aluguel, Assinatura e Compra de veículos;  Programa de Livre Escolha (Reembolso de Despesas Médicas);  Vale Alimentação e Refeição;  Allya;  Auxílio Home office;  Wellhub;  Plano de Saúde;  Plano Odontológico;  Seguro de Vida.

Requisitos obrigatórios    Experiência sólida com  Terraform  e infraestrutura como código;   Vivência prática em  cloud  (AWS, Azure ou GCP), especialmente em serviços de dados;   Forte conhecimento em  pipelines  ,  ETL/ELT  e arquiteturas de dados (Data Lake, DW, Lakehouse);   Proficiência em  Python  e  SQL;    Experiência com  CI/CD  aplicado a dados e automação;   Conhecimentos de containers (Docker) e, desejável, Kubernetes.    Diferenciais   Criação de bibliotecas ou módulos Terraform em escala corporativa;  Experiência com orquestradores como Airflow, Prefect, Dagster ou Step Functions;  Conhecimento de ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (Cloud Watch, Grafana, Datadog);  Certificações cloud ou de engenharia de dados.    Perfil comportamental   Liderança técnica e capacidade de influenciar padrões e boas práticas;  Comunicação clara para dialogar com áreas técnicas e não técnicas;  Proatividade e visão sistêmica de plataforma. title: Gerente de projetos de ti sênior
description:
Confira a vaga para Gerente de projetos de ti sênior em chapecó. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.  Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.  Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS.  Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).  Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.    Informações Adicionais   Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica) Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil) Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos) Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte) Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

title: Direct-response creative strategist
description:
Empresa está contratando Direct-response creative strategist em bento gonçalves. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About us Clickbait Agency is a You Tube ad creative and media buying agency. We only work with 8 and 9-figure DTC brands and our focus is simple, producing video creatives that scale profitably on You Tube and this means that you’ll be working directly on accounts most agencies don’t get near.  We care deeply about being the best at what we do which means fast iteration, high standards, and creatives that spend millions. We’ve built proprietary AI systems that support our creative and production workflows, and our video production runs through a dedicated team of AI prompters, so strategists can stay focused on strategy.  We think You Tube creative is going through a significant shift right now and we’re positioning ourselves at the front of it.  The role  We’re looking for a creative strategist who understands direct response at a serious level and can develop and script You Tube ads and mini VSLs for competitive ecommerce markets.  You’ll be responsible for research, angle development, hook writing, scripting, and iterating based on performance data. title: Senior web developer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior web developer em curitiba. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.
