title: Full stack software engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Full stack software engineer em americana. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

About LINES  LINES is a real-time, community-driven going-out platform — live venue videos, wait times, event listings, and exclusive deals across London, Melbourne, Sydney, and Brisbane. Tens of thousands of users rely on us every weekend.  We're scaling fast and migrating from Firebase to a fully owned AWS backend to power real-time feeds, ticketing, and what's next.   What you'll do  Design backend systems for real-time, localized, event-driven timelines (Twitter/Instagram-style) Architect feeds: fanout, ranking, filtering, personalization  Build performant APIs for mobile and web clients  Own features end-to-end — architecture, implementation, deployment, observability  Build ticketing flows: inventory, reservations, consistency, concurrency  Build ingestion pipelines (scrapers, cron, integrations) for the event database  Design data models for high-write, real-time systems  Work directly with the founder on product and technical direction  Improve infrastructure, reliability, and developer workflows  Write short specs — problem, approach, tradeoffs — to move faster, not slower     What we expect  Strong backend fundamentals, systems-first mindset  Experience with feeds, timelines, ranking, fanout, or personalization  Solid distributed systems chops: consistency, idempotency, concurrency, tradeoffs  Designs for scale even when the system is still small  Hands-on with Redis, and knows when to reach for it  Experience with SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar  Comfortable with high-write, read-heavy workloads and eventual consistency  Pragmatic — ships impact, not over-engineering  Thrives in early-stage chaos with shifting priorities  Decides with incomplete info and iterates fast  Daily use of AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor) without compromising quality     Tech stack  Backend:  Nest JS (Node.js), Type Script   Infra:  AWS (Elastic Beanstalk, SQS, SNS, S3, Lambda), Cloudflare   Data:  Postgres (migrating), Firebase (legacy)  Frontend:  Next.js, Expo (React Native) CI/CD:  Git Hub Actions     Nice to have  Built or scaled social feeds or marketplaces  Ticketing, booking, or inventory experience  Firebase familiarity (helpful during migration) Real-time systems (chat, live updates, video) React Native or Expo   ﻿ Apply here:

Operations & Project Manager | Life Supply USA | Remote | Latin America  How to Apply   We do not accept applications through Linked In.   To be considered, please record a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself, describing a project or process you have owned end-to-end, and explaining why this role is the right next step for you. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. Send your video link and resume to  .   About Us   Life Supply USA is one of the fastest-growing e-commerce retailers of household essentials in the United States, specializing in air filters, HVAC filters, extension cords, and home goods. We operate across Amazon, Shopify, Walmart, and additional marketplaces with a lean, high-performance remote team. We are scaling fast and hiring the person who will keep the entire operation running like a machine.  The Role   We are hiring an  Operations & Project Manager  to serve as the execution backbone of the business and the primary management layer between our COO and our team.  This is  not  a coordinator role. This is a real management position with real authority.  You will own our operational rhythm, enforce accountability across every function, resolve blockers before they become problems, and ensure the entire team executes with precision, without the COO needing to be involved in day-to-day issues.  If things fall through the cracks, it is your job to catch them before anyone else notices.  Remote | Growth path to COO  What You Will Own    Click Up Environment  Own the Click Up workspace as the single source of truth for all work in progress. Enforce task hygiene daily. Audit weekly. Onboard new team members to standards.   Deadline Tracking & Escalation  Monitor all active tasks and projects for deadline risk proactively. Maintain a weekly at-risk task list. Surface root cause analysis to the COO when patterns emerge.   Meeting Cadence Ownership  Own all recurring meetings end to end: Daily Standup, Weekly 1:1s, COO Operations Review, Project Kickoffs, and Monthly Ops Review. Agendas distributed 24 hours in advance. Notes and action items distributed within 24 hours of each meeting.   Cross-Team Coordination & Blocker Resolution  Serve as the coordination layer between all functions. No team member should be stuck on a blocker for more than 24 hours without a resolution plan.   Workload & Priority Management  Monitor workload distribution across the team. Surface imbalances to the COO with recommended reallocation before output is affected.   KPI Dashboard Management  Own the weekly KPI reporting cycle. Compile and present the consolidated dashboard to the COO weekly. Flag all missed KPIs immediately with root cause and action plan.   Operational SOP Library  Own the company's full SOP library. Every recurring operational workflow documented and current.   Team Accountability  Hold every team member directly accountable for tasks, deadlines, and Click Up hygiene, without involving the COO in routine accountability conversations.  Your KPI Scorecard   ✅ Click Up Task Hygiene (owner + due date + status): 98%+ ✅ Deadline Adherence Rate: 90%+ ✅ Overdue Task Rate: 5% or less ✅ Meeting Agenda Coverage: 100% ✅ KPI Dashboard Timeliness: 100% ✅ SOP Coverage: 100% What You Will Need  ✅ ✔ Proven experience in operations management or project management in a fast-paced remote environment ✔ Strong hands-on experience with Click Up (required) or equivalent PM tools (Monday.com, Asana, Notion) ✔ Experience managing or coordinating a distributed, cross-functional team ✔ Exceptional organizational skills with a bias toward action, clarity, and follow-through ✔ Ability to make independent judgment calls and resolve issues without constant escalation ✔ Excellent written and spoken English ✔ Experience building and maintaining SOPs and operational documentation ✔ E-commerce or operations background is a strong plus ✔ Self-motivated, highly organized, and committed to a single full-time role  Your Authority   You will have real, day-to-day management authority to:  Reprioritize tasks and reassign workload across the team  Hold team members accountable for missed deadlines  Resolve cross-team blockers and coordination conflicts  Give direct feedback on execution standards  Make judgment calls on task sequencing and urgency  Approve minor process changes that do not affect KPIs or strategy    Growth Path   Operations & Project Manager → Senior Operations Manager →  Chief Operating Officer   The growth path is real. Phase 1 is about building credibility through execution discipline and demonstrating the judgment to manage independently.  What We Offer   Competitive base salary plus performance bonuses 100% remote Paid time off Clear, defined path to COO Real management authority from day one A lean, high-performance team that values direct communication and results  Important Notes  ⚠️ No freelancers or part-time applicants Gross salary — candidate handles own taxes Full commitment required: no other clients or roles  How to Apply   We do not accept applications through Linked In.   To be considered, please record a short Loom video (2 to 3 minutes) introducing yourself, describing a project or process you have owned end-to-end, and explaining why this role is the right next step for you. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed. Send your video link and resume to  .   We are moving quickly. Strong candidates will hear back fast.

title: Gerente de projetos de ti sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Gerente de projetos de ti sênior em gravataí. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a WWS  Somos uma consultoria de TI especializada em conectar profissionais de alta performance a projetos estratégicos em grandes organizações. Nosso propósito é equilibrar eficiência operacional e inovação, gerando valor real para os negócios e construindo um futuro sólido e competitivo para nossos clientes.  Sobre a vaga   Esta é uma oportunidade para atuar como Gerente de Projetos de TI em um ambiente de alta complexidade e grande escala no setor de Agronegócio.  Você será o elo entre times técnicos e áreas de negócio, liderando entregas que impactam diretamente a operação de uma das maiores empresas do setor. É um papel estratégico, que exige visão sistêmica, governança e capacidade de tomada de decisão em projetos críticos.  Responsabilidades   Gestão de Portfólio: Estruturar, monitorar e reportar indicadores de desempenho (KPIs) e status de múltiplos projetos, garantindo aderência a cronogramas, custos e escopo.  Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências.  Relacionamento com Negócio: Atuar como ponto focal para áreas de negócio (operações, logística, supply chain), traduzindo necessidades em entregas de TI.  Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS.  Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e tradicionais (Cascata).  Capacidade de gestão de stakeholders e fornecedores externos.    Informações Adicionais   Regime de Contratação: PJ (pessoa jurídica) Local de Trabalho: Remoto (Brasil) Viagens: Pontuais (a combinar, com custos cobertos) Setor da Cliente: Agronegócio (grande porte) Diferencial: Vivência em projetos de cadeia de suprimentos, logística ou operações agroindustriais.

Background Técnico: Orientar times e conduzir projetos de implementação, evolução e integração de sistemas ERP (e idealmente WMS), mapeando riscos e dependências. Governança e Processos: Aplicar boas práticas de gerenciamento de projetos (PMBOK, Ágil ou Híbrido), gestão de mudanças e qualidade.    Requisitos   Experiência comprovada como Gerente de Projetos de TI em médias/grandes empresas.  Domínio sólido em projetos ERP (SAP, Oracle, Totvs, ou similares).  Conhecimento em WMS. title: Senior web developer
description:
Confira a vaga para Senior web developer em viamão. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About the Role  We're looking for a Modern Web Developer to design, build, and ship high-quality websites across our agency group — primarily in Word Press and Hub Spot, but increasingly using AI-native build tools like Lovable, Claude Code, and Cursor.  This is not a classic Word Press role buried in PHP. We need someone who is technically broad and modern: comfortable in a CMS, fluent in modern Java Script and APIs, and excited to use AI coding tools to ship faster than a traditional dev shop. You'll build marketing sites, landing pages, and lightweight web apps — and just as often, wire those sites into the rest of our stack via APIs, webhooks, and automations.  If you love shipping polished, conversion-ready sites and you're allergic to bloated,  brittle Word Press builds, you'll fit right in.  Key Responsibilities   Website Development   Design and build production-grade marketing websites in Word Press (custom themes/blocks, ACF, headless setups where appropriate) and Hub Spot CMS (Hub L templating, modules, themes).  Use Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, and similar AI-native tools to accelerate  prototyping and full builds — for client work and internal tools alike.  Build clean, performant, accessible front-end experiences (semantic HTML, modern CSS, vanilla JS or framework-as-needed).  Maintain and extend existing client sites: new pages, modules, redesigns, performance tuning, and migrations.    API Integrations & Automation Hooks   Integrate websites with Hub Spot, Salesforce, marketing automation platforms, analytics tools, and custom APIs.  Wire up form submissions, gated content, and lead routing to webhooks, n8n flows, and serverless functions.  Build lightweight internal tools, microsites, and utilities when a full CMS is overkill (Vercel, Netlify, Cloudflare Workers, etc.).    Quality, Performance & SEO   Own Core Web Vitals, page speed, schema markup, and on-page technical SEO basics for every site you ship.  Implement analytics and tracking correctly (GA4, GTM, Hub Spot tracking, server-side events where needed).  Test thoroughly across devices and browsers; care about the details.    Collaboration   Work directly with designers, strategists, and marketers to translate Figma into pixel-faithful, on-brand builds.  Participate in code reviews, version control workflows (Git/Git Hub), and documentation.  Help define internal standards for how we build sites across the agency group going forward.    Required Skills   Technical   3+ years building production websites in Word Press (custom themes, blocks, ACF, plugin selection and customization).  Strong Hub Spot CMS experience (Hub L, modules, themes, forms, smart content).  Proficient in HTML, CSS, Java Script — comfortable with modern tooling, build steps, and at least one JS framework when needed (React/Next.js a plus).  Hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Lovable, Claude Code, Cursor, Replit, or equivalent) — and a clear point of view on when to use them vs. when to write code yourself.  Solid understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, OAuth, and serverless functions.  Comfortable in Git/Git Hub with branching, PRs, and basic CI/CD.    Modern Web Skills   Performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, image optimization, caching strategies).  Technical SEO fundamentals (schema, sitemaps, redirects, canonical handling).  Accessibility basics (WCAG, semantic HTML, keyboard navigation).  Analytics and tag management (GA4, GTM, server-side tracking).    Bonus Experience   (Not required, but highly valuable) Webflow development experience.  Headless Word Press or Hub Spot setups (Next.js + WP/Hub Spot APIs).  Experience with Supabase, Postgres, or Firebase for lightweight app backends.  Familiarity with n8n, Make.com, or Zapier for stitching sites into broader workflows.  E-commerce experience (Woo Commerce, Shopify).  Design sensibility — you can read a Figma file and notice when something is off without being told.    Soft Skills   Bias toward shipping. You'd rather get a working v1 live than debate architecture for two weeks.  Detail-oriented — you care about pixel alignment, spacing, and typography as much as the underlying code.  Strong communicator with non-technical teammates; you can explain trade-offs to a strategist or account lead without jargon.  Curious about new tools and models — you experiment on your own time and bring ideas back to the team.  Comfortable juggling multiple sites and clients in a fast-moving agency environment.    What Success Looks Like   In the first 60–90 days, you will:  Ship at least 2–3 client websites or major redesigns end-to-end.  Establish standards for how we use AI coding tools across web builds (when to reach for Lovable, when to drop into Claude Code, when to write it ourselves).  Integrate at least one site deeply with our automation stack (Hub Spot, n8n, custom APIs) in a way that becomes a reusable pattern.  Become the internal go-to person for technical web questions across the agency group.

title: Desenvolvedor de firmware — sistemas embarcados (c / arm cortex-m / esp32)
description:
Empresa está contratando Desenvolvedor de firmware — sistemas embarcados (c / arm cortex-m / esp32) em santa catarina. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a Ageon  Somos uma indústria eletrônica brasileira que, desde 2001, desenvolve, produz e comercializa controladores de temperatura e inversores de frequência  para os mercados de refrigeração, aquecimento, climatização, fitness e automação industrial. Nossos produtos rodam em aplicações no Brasil e no exterior, sustentados por três pilares:  inovação, tecnologia e melhoria contínua  . Conheça em ageon.com.br.  Sobre a vaga   Estamos reforçando nosso time de P& D para acelerar o desenvolvimento da próxima geração de produtos. Você participará do ciclo completo do firmware — da arquitetura à homologação — em produtos reais que vão para o chão de fábrica de clientes em vários setores. É uma oportunidade para quem gosta de resolver problemas técnicos de baixo nível, entender o hardware ao seu redor e ver o código rodando em algo físico  .  O que você vai fazer    Projetar, codificar e validar firmware em  C  para microcontroladores  ARM Cortex-M  e  ESP32 .   Implementar rotinas de leitura de sensores, controle e comunicação com periféricos via SPI, I² C, UART.  Desenvolver e manter protocolos de comunicação industrial ( Modbus RTU/TCP  , RS-485) e  conectividade Io T (Wi-Fi, MQTT) .   Trabalhar lado a lado com a equipe de hardware na depuração e bring-up de placas.  Criar e manter testes preliminares, documentação técnica e versionamento dos firmwares no repositório (Git).  Planejar cronograma, contribuir com decisões de arquitetura e encaminhar projetos para homologação.  Evoluir produtos existentes conforme novas demandas dos clientes e do mercado.    O que esperamos de você (requisitos)   Experiência prática com desenvolvimento de  firmware/software embarcado em linguagem C  .   Vivência com  microcontroladores ARM Cortex-M  (STM32)  e ESP32 .   Domínio de periféricos e protocolos embarcados (UART, SPI, I² C, GPIO, timers, interrupções).  Familiaridade com  Git  e fluxo de versionamento.   Capacidade de ler  datasheets em inglês  .   Formação em Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia Eletrônica/Elétrica, Mecatrônica, Automação, Ciência da Computação ou áreas afins (ou experiência equivalente).    Diferenciais (não eliminatórios)   Experiência com  aplicações Io T  e arquiteturas conectadas ( MQTT  , brokers, integração com nuvem).   Vivência com  Free RTOS  ou outro RTOS.   Conhecimento em  Modbus  , RS-485 ou outros protocolos industriais.   Experiência com bootloaders e atualização  OTA / firmware update  .   Pós-graduação ou especialização em Sistemas Embarcados, Engenharia de Software, Desenvolvimento de Produtos ou áreas correlatas.    O que oferecemos    Estabilidade de uma indústria com 25 anos de mercado  e produtos próprios.   Plano de saúde.  Vale alimentação ou refeição.  Vale-transporte e estacionamento no local.  Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR) .   Convênios com farmácia, academia, centro de estética, restaurantes e instituições de ensino (técnico, graduação e pós-graduação) — incentivo direto à sua formação continuada.  Ambiente técnico onde você verá seu firmware rodando em produtos físicos vendidos no Brasil e exterior.    Detalhes da vaga    Regime:  CLT (efetivo)  Modelo:  Presencial — Jardim Eldorado, Palhoça/SC   Horário:  Segunda a quinta, das 8h às 12h e das 13h às 18h; sextas, das 8h às 12h e das 13h às 17h  Nível:  Júnior / Pleno

title: Engenheiro(a) de dados sênior | databricks e inglês avançado
description:
Empresa está contratando Engenheiro(a) de dados sênior | databricks e inglês avançado em brusque. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Muito prazer, somos a United Hub Digital, uma consultoria de tecnologia nearshore que combina inovação, excelência técnica e agilidade para transformar negócios  Na UHub, somos impulsionados pelo propósito de liderar a transformação digital com excelência e agilidade. A flexibilidade é uma das nossas marcas registradas. Atuamos com diferentes modelos e formatos de time, adaptando-nos ao contexto de cada cliente. Nosso diferencial está em entregar soluções de ponta com uma equipe enxuta, eficiente e com mentalidade de dono.  O Que Você Vai Fazer   Estamos procurando um Senior Databricks Engineer com experiência na construção de pipelines e desenvolvimento de processos ETL no Databricks para agregar ao nosso Databricks Co E. Nesta função, você desempenhará um papel essencial na interseção entre negócios e tecnologia, combinando profundo conhecimento técnico com a capacidade de alinhar soluções tecnológicas aos objetivos estratégicos da empresa.  O Que Estamos Buscando   Inglês Avançado/Fluente;  5+ anos de experiência com manipulação e engenharia de dados  5+ anos com processos ETL  3+ anos de experiência com Databricks  3+ anos de experiência com Azure  Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) Excelente comunicação e colaboração em equipe  Esta função pode gerar oportunidades de viagens domésticas e/ou internacionais;     Será Um Diferencial Se Você   Vivência em projetos internacionais e equipes multiculturais  Experiência com Power BI e integração entre engenharia e BI  Curiosidade e desejo de se envolver em diferentes etapas do ciclo de dados (desde ingestão até visualização)    Onde Você Vai Trabalhar    Esta é uma posição para atuação 100% remota     Modalidade De Contratação    CLT ou PJ.

title: Forensic manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Forensic manager em cabreúva. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

This leading multinational group, with significant operations across the Americas and worldwide, is seeking an experienced Forensic Manager to lead a team of corporate investigators across their regional operations. Based in Belo Horizonte, you will be responsible for managing a team of forensic specialists who are overseeing investigations into complex financial crimes, including conflict-of-interest, procurement fraud, misappropriation of assets, corruption, and bribery.  Your role will be primarily focused on team leadership, setting key performance objectives, and building strategic relationships to ensure seamless regional operations. You will have day-to-day responsibility for managing forensic specialists, providing career development guidance, and overseeing resource allocation. Furthermore, you will serve as the primary point of contact for operational management while playing a key role in the overall strategic management of the group’s investigative objectives.  In addition to your leadership duties, you will undertake high-level corporate investigation projects, conduct fraud awareness training, and oversee the integration of data analytics into investigative workflows.  To be successful in this role, you should possess extensive experience in leading complex corporate investigations and managing specialized forensic teams. You are likely currently working in a managerial capacity within a forensic advisory firm or a comparable corporate business.  While a CFE qualification is highly welcomed, we value your proven ability to lead high-performance teams and manage senior stakeholder relationships. Excellent communication skills are essential, and candidates must be fluent in both Portuguese and English. Proficiency in Spanish and experience with advanced data analytics tools are welcomed.  For more information, please see our  video
